title: [01/07/2025] - Smoked fish Production
prompt: The diagram below shows the process of producing smoked fish. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The provided diagram illustrates the linear process of producing smoked fish.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the production involves a multi-stage, linear process that begins with catching the fish and finishes with the final product being sold in stores. The main phases include initial processing, preparation and preservation, and finally packaging and distribution.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The process commences with fish being caught at sea using nets and transported by boat to a port. Upon arrival, the fish are frozen for storage purposes, after which they are thawed in fresh water before being cut open. The next step involves soaking the prepared fish in a mixture of salt water and yellow coloring.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Following the salting and coloring stage, the fish undergo a smoking process. Once smoked, they are placed into boxes for packaging, and these packages are subsequently frozen at 0 degrees Celsius and kept in a cold storage facility. In the final stage, the smoked fish are distributed by trucks to various fish stores, where they are made available for sale to customers.
